review_description: Don't use this company. We have been over-sold and under delivered!! Our system was installed in December 2017 and it's still not working properly. Communication with the company at best is poor or non-existant. Can't contact the owner to discuss issues. As a side note the sub-contractor installers are fantastic. They are doing everything they possibly can to rectify our problems, however Victorian Solar Solutions are not an honest company to deal with. BUYER BEWARE!!!
